messages:
natalie_p: postmortem follow-up: we've seen repeated partial responses and reconnect storms across streaming/chat. postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortem/streaming-mar2026. need owners, short rollouts, and measurable rollback gates. who takes detection, server mitigation, client guidance?

ops-bot: incident logged STREAM-2026-03-STREAMPARTIAL (sev3).

devon: i'll own reconnect heuristics + server soft-close. plan: land conservative defaults, expose reconnect_attempts_per_session, and add an automated short-circuit for noisy clients. ETA: design note by 2465002100, PR + tests by 2465003600.

marta: i'll own detection/observability. will add stream.partial_count metric (per-cluster, per-model), create a 'partial-resp' dashboard, and set a low-sensitivity alert to start. ETA metrics+alert by 2465003000, dashboard by 2465004200.

kevin_oncall: i'll own SDK guidance and canary plan. tasks: add client config `gracefulReconnect` defaults, emit telemetry when client reduces concurrency, and run canary in dedicated-us-west. ETA SDK PR by 2465004800.

natalie_p: short-term mitigations we can flip in prod within hours: (A) throttle max_streams_per_token to 6, (B) lower reconnect_rate_limit to 8/s per IP, (C) enable partial-response alert at low sensitivity. who can flip A+B now?

devon: I can flip B now, monitor 30m and revert if we see regressions.

lia_debug: feature-toggle change accepted for B by devon.

ops-bot: feature toggle applied: reconnect_rate_limit=8/s by devon (staging->prod queued).

marta: detection note: runtime will emit trace attribute `stream.partial_likely=true` when first chunk < 24 bytes and connection closes within 150ms. will use that to drive metrics without client changes.

kevin_oncall: SDK behavior: if telemetry sees `stream.partial_likely` >=3 events in 10m for a token, SDK will reduce client concurrency by 50% and backoff 2s. opt-out via `client.enablePartialBackoff=false`.

devon: draft server config i'm testing: ```yaml
stream:
  drain_window_ms: 1500
  noisy_token_cooldown_s: 90
  max_streams_per_token: 6
  reconnect:
    max_retries: 6
    base_delay_ms: 250
    max_delay_ms: 5000
```

marta: tests: add e2e case injecting small-chunk writes, assert `stream.partial_likely=true` trace and `stream.partial_count++`. include sampled raw-chunk logs (1%).

natalie_p: add rollback gates: if canary p95 latency increases >20% or error rate increases >10% for 15m, auto-revert feature flags. annotate flags with playbook link.

devon: will add automated revert and playbook link.

kevin_oncall: creating tracker STREAM-TKT-7001 with subtasks and owners. will link PRs and canary dashboards.

marta: propose daily 10m rollout check for first 3 days, then weekly until stable.

natalie_p: action summary (short):
- reconnect + soft-close: owner @devon, deliverable config+soft-circuit+metric, due 2465003600
- detection & dashboard: owner @marta, deliverable metric+trace+alert+dashboard, due 2465004200
- SDK guidance & canary: owner @kevin_oncall, deliverable SDK PR+docs+canary, due 2465004800

ops-bot: calendar event created: Streaming Partial/Reconnect Triage (recurring) by natalie_p.

devon: will post status here after canary completes. please keep updates short. thanks. :rocket:
